proof:
Source: parent proof, step 3 (smooth Poincaré inequality on cubes, by coordinate paths): for a cube Q of side s = 1 − 2δ, ∫_Q∫_Q|v(x) − v(y)| ≤ Σ_i s·Lⁿ(Q)·∫_Q|∂_i v| ≤ n·s·Lⁿ(Q)·∫_Q|Dv|, with n = m + 1.
Dependency: sibling coordinate_step (Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_cp_coordinate_step).
Notation: E := Euclid (m + 1), Q := Q_δ, e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1. For k ∈ Fin (m + 1), a_k and b_k are as in coordinate_step.

1. Telescoping (coordinate paths). For x, y ∈ E and r ∈ {0, …, m + 1}, let W_r(x, y) := WithLp.toLp 2 (j ↦ y_j if (j : ℕ) < r else x_j).
 – W_0 = x, because no j has j < 0.
 – W_{m+1} = y, because every j ∈ Fin (m + 1) has j < m + 1.
 – For k ∈ Fin (m + 1): W_k = a_k(x, y), since (j : ℕ) < (k : ℕ) ⟺ j < k. Also W_{k+1} = b_k(x, y), since (j : ℕ) < k + 1 ⟺ j ≤ k.
 Hence (Finset.sum_range_sub' after Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range)
 v(x) − v(y) = Σ_{r=0}^{m} (v(W_r) − v(W_{r+1})) = Σ_{k ∈ Fin (m+1)} (v(a_k(x, y)) − v(b_k(x, y))),
 and so |v(x) − v(y)| ≤ Σ_k |v(a_k(x, y)) − v(b_k(x, y))|.

2. Integrability. v is continuous and Q̄ is compact; for x, y ∈ Q every W_r(x, y) lies in Q. So all functions (x, y) ↦ |v(x) − v(y)| and (x, y) ↦ |v(a_k) − v(b_k)| are continuous and bounded on Q × Q. Since volume(Q) < ∞ (Q is bounded), they are integrable for (volume⌞Q) ⊗ (volume⌞Q). Their partial integrals in y are integrable in x (Fubini). Hence the iterated integrals are monotone and additive over the finite sum (integral_finset_sum, applied to the inner and then to the outer integral).

3. Integrating step 1 and applying the sibling coordinate_step for each k (hypotheses: v is C¹, 0 ≤ δ < 1/2):
 ∫_Q∫_Q|v(x) − v(y)| ≤ Σ_k ∫_Q∫_Q|v(a_k) − v(b_k)| ≤ Σ_k (1 − 2δ)·volume(Q)·∫_Q|Dv(x)e_k| dx.

4. Directional derivatives. For every x and k: |Dv(x)e_k| ≤ ‖Dv(x)‖·‖e_k‖ = ‖Dv(x)‖, since ‖e_k‖ = 1 (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm). Both functions are continuous, hence integrable on Q, so ∫_Q|Dv(x)e_k| ≤ ∫_Q‖Dv‖ for each of the m + 1 indices k. The factor (1 − 2δ)·volume(Q) is ≥ 0 (δ < 1/2). Therefore
 ∫_Q∫_Q|v(x) − v(y)| dy dx ≤ (m + 1)·(1 − 2δ)·volume(Q)·∫_Q‖Dv(x)‖ dx. ∎

Compiled Lean check of the telescoping identity of step 1 (against `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, comparator scope):
```lean
example (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (x y : Euclid (m + 1)) :
    v x - v y = ∑ k : Fin (m + 1),
      (v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j < k then y j else x j)) -
        v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j ≤ k then y j else x j))) := by
  set W : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1) := fun n => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if (j : ℕ) < n then y j else x j)
    with hW
  have h0 : W 0 = x := by
    simp [hW]
  have hN : W (m + 1) = y := by
    have hlt : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (j : ℕ) < m + 1 := fun j => j.is_lt
    simp only [hW, hlt, ite_true]
  have hk : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j < k then y j else x j)) -
        v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j ≤ k then y j else x j)) = v (W k) - v (W (k + 1)) := by
    intro k
    have e1 : (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => if j < k then y j else x j) =
        (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => if (j : ℕ) < (k : ℕ) then y j else x j) := by
      funext j
      simp only [Fin.lt_def]
    have e2 : (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => if j ≤ k then y j else x j) =
        (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => if (j : ℕ) < (k : ℕ) + 1 then y j else x j) := by
      funext j
      simp only [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    rw [e1, e2]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hk k)]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun n => v (W n) - v (W (n + 1))) (m + 1)]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_sub', h0, hN]
```
key_steps: Telescope along the coordinate path W_0 = x, …, W_{m+1} = y with W_k = a_k(x, y), W_{k+1} = b_k(x, y).
All integrands are continuous and bounded on Q_δ × Q_δ, so the iterated integrals are additive and monotone.
Apply sibling coordinate_step to each of the m + 1 terms.
